items.canonicalEnglishName: Lettuce leaves, washed and thinly sliced
items.notes: Lettuce leaves/head, washed, trimmed or sliced, remain raw lettuce. The cultivar is unspecified, so use the generic raw-lettuce record rather than selecting iceberg, romaine or red-leaf lettuce or a dressed salad. Trimming and piece size do not establish yield.
A pinch of salt names salt only. Use generic table salt without inventing the mass of a pinch or asserting iodization; do not include pepper or another seasoning.
Saffron powder/ground saffron is the single saffron spice, not saffron rice or a seasoning blend. Retain the saffron reference without inferring a sachet, teaspoon or thread mass.

Plain butter is only softened, brought to room temperature, cut, or melted for later use. The salt status is unspecified, so use Butter, NFS rather than choosing salted or unsalted butter. Exclude butter already mixed with chocolate or flour; no clarified-butter conversion.
Ice/ice cubes are plain water in a physical frozen state, not flavored or sweetened ice. Use Water, NFS; no cube volume, cube mass or density conversion is inferred.

Mangetout/snow peas/sugar-snap peas are edible-podded peas, raw with washing, cutting or string removal only. Use generic raw edible-podded peas rather than shelled mature peas, frozen peas or boiled peas. No exact cultivar or trimming-yield claim.
Apricot flesh is peeled and quartered only; use generic raw apricot, not dried apricots, compote or syrup-packed fruit. This is not a cultivar or peeling-yield analysis.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Beaten egg (size M), brought to room temperature
items.notes: Beaten whole egg brought to room temperature remains raw fresh whole egg. No salt, milk or other ingredient is stated. Egg size does not establish shell-free edible mass; do not use a cooked egg or yolk-only profile.

Cavolo nero/kale leaves, washed and chopped only, match generic raw kale. The stated alternative is within kale, not a different food. Do not use cooked or frozen kale; no cultivar-specific nutrients or trimming yield are asserted.

items.canonicalEnglishName: Parsnip, peeled and sliced into rounds
items.notes: Parsnip is peeled and cut only, with no cooking or additions. Use raw parsnips, not parsley root or boiled parsnips. Chips/fries here describe the cut, not frying; lengths and widths do not imply mass or cooking yield.

Turnip leaves are explicitly the greens, thinly sliced and uncooked. Use raw turnip greens, not turnip root, cooked greens or a mixed green vegetable.

Coriander powder/ground coriander denotes the dry seed spice in this ingredient wording. Use coriander seed rather than raw cilantro foliage, dried leaf, or a compound paste. The optional or finishing qualifier does not change food identity.

items.canonicalEnglishName: A- pumpkin, seeds and skin removed, cut into 3 cm cubes
items.notes: Pumpkin is raw and only cut, with seed/skin removal where stated. Use generic raw pumpkin, not microwaved pumpkin, pumpkin puree or pumpkin with explicitly retained skin; no cut-size or trimming-yield assumption.
